id_rule: 17000 + 4 * position in drpg-leases.json bases + n (n = the skill's place among the base's own skills, 0-2); recorded per row
source: JP client masters command / charactercommand / charactermagiccommand (sha256 in the census file); Global not used

rules.E: source name == a D5 magic.dat JP name (exact, one row): the D5 row itself is linked
rules.A_power: damage: effect1_value = source level-1 percent - 100; power_lv1..10 = 100 .. 100 + (level-50 percent - level-1 percent), linear (D5 reads effect value + level table - 100, FUN_1401D7A20)
rules.A_support: stat change / ailment as main effect: copy of the D5 spell of that effect, power_lv1..10 = source level-1 .. level-50 magnitude (formula 5 / 6 rows read the level table as the magnitude)
rules.A_sp: sp_cost = source SP at skill level 1 (the RPG cost falls with level, D5's rises: D5's own rule applies from there)
rules.A_element: fire 1, wind 2, star 4, water -> ice 3 (the RPG's water spell is D5's ice spell)
rules.A_target: the RPG has no map: one enemy -> a one-panel stand-in, all enemies -> a multi-panel stand-in; range and area are the stand-in's own
rules.A_riders: added effects on the skill's own targets that D5 has as an effect slot keep the source number; all others are dropped and listed per skill
rules.unlock: charactercommand.lv (character level 1 / 50 / 200) is the learn level, verbatim
rules.X: main effect without a D5 skill-row meaning: not built, the pack's D5 lookalike stays (donor)
rules.M1: weapon-mastery spells (charactermagiccommand) that D5 has under the same name are learned at character level = the source's weapon mastery level; OFF until decided
rules.C1: drop the D5 lookalikes of the costume looks' skills from the learn list; OFF until decided
